response.original_title: {FAQ™Extra Room} Can I Add an Extra Room to My Disney Cruise Reservation?
response.overview: You can add a room to an existing Disney Cruises booking by calling Disney Cruise Customer Service at +1-866-254-7549 or contacting your travel agent. To add rooms to a Disney Cruise, you must call Disney Cruise directly at ☎️ +1-866-254-7549(US/Canada) or +44-120-420-8151(UK) or contact your travel agent, as this cannot be done online. Additions depend on stateroom capacity, ship lifeboat capacity, and current availability ☎️ +1-866-254-7549(US/Canada) or +44-120-420-8151(UK). The booking will likely be re-priced at current rates. To add someone to an existing Disney Cruise room, you must call Disney Cruise directly at ☎️ +1-866-254-7549(US/Canada) or +44-120-420-8151(UK), or contact your travel agent, as this cannot be done via the website or app.
